Many professionals eat lunch at their desk most days of the week. That's a fact, not a failure.

We help clients build eating patterns that fit their actual schedule and their actual workplace.

No shame. No rigid meal rules. Just practical support from an experienced and compassionate team of behavioral healthcare professionals.

We serve clients both onsite in San Antonio and virtual across Texas. Learn more about the program schedule at bariatriccounselingcenter.com/program-schedule/

payload.title: Tue 11/10: Referring providers: weight loss medications and the behavioral half
payload.purpose: Patients on weight loss medications (never the drug class abbreviation): the habits that keep the result. Document post.

captions.LI:
Patients on weight loss medications need more than the prescription. They need the behavioral tools to sustain the result.

At the Bariatric Counseling Center, we provide group and individual therapy, dietary guidance, cooking classes, chef-prepared meals, mindful eating and movement education in a unique, all-inclusive format, led by an experienced and compassionate team of behavioral healthcare professionals. One program, not four.

The program can be standalone behavioral treatment for obesity, or in addition to bariatric surgery or weight loss medication that patients receive from their medical providers. Our team coordinates care with referring medical providers and, at patient discharge, we give referring providers a detailed summary of the patient's behavioral progress during the time in our intensive outpatient program, including changes in assessment scores measuring nutrition quality of life, disordered eating, anxiety, and depression, among other metrics.

We accept most health insurances. Our claims are processed under patients' mental health benefits. Our Director of Admissions is Leloni Gonzales at lgonzales@bccsanantonio.com and 210-634-2200.

San Antonio and virtual across Texas.

#BehavioralHealth

payload.title: Mon 11/23: What intuitive eating means here
payload.purpose: Intuitive Eating as taught in the program, with a clinical psychologist and registered dietitians in the room.

captions.FB:
Intuitive eating means learning to trust your body's signals again.

At the Bariatric Counseling Center, intuitive eating is taught by a clinical psychologist and registered dietitians working together in the same program. You learn to recognize hunger and fullness cues, understand emotional triggers, and build a healthier relationship with food.

This isn't about rules or restrictions. It's about understanding and modifying your relationship with food through behavioral therapy, dietary guidance, culinary classes, and mindful movement. One program, not four.

Our Intensive Outpatient Program runs about three months, meeting two to three times per week. Sessions are available mornings, evenings, and weekends, both virtual and onsite. San Antonio and virtual across Texas.

Most health insurance plans cover the program at little to no cost under mental health benefits.

Link in the first comment.

#BariatricCounseling #SanAntonio
captions.IG:
Intuitive eating with clinical support

At the Bariatric Counseling Center, intuitive eating is taught by a clinical psychologist and registered dietitians working together in the same program. You learn to recognize hunger and fullness cues, understand emotional triggers, and build a healthier relationship with food.

This approach combines behavioral therapy, dietary guidance, culinary classes, and mindful movement. One program, not four.

Our experienced and compassionate team helps people struggling with binge eating, chronic overeating, and obesity. Sessions meet two to three times per week for about three months, available mornings, evenings, and weekends.

San Antonio and virtual across Texas. Most health insurance plans cover the program under mental health benefits.
